title: What is proven, what is not, what comes next
blurb: An honest ledger as of Oct 9: which parts have a result, which are only built or planned, and what would prove the idea wrong.

scenes.heading: Result one: the thinking does the work
caption: Result one. On 6,040 questions kept aside, the model scored 73.01 out of 100 with its thinking on.
With thinking switched off it scored 0.66. A plain model of the same size scored 67.12.
So the thinking does the work, on one copy at the smallest size. Bigger sizes are untested.

scenes.heading: Result two: the calculator can sit outside

caption.text: Result two. The calculator is plain code outside the model: it gets a slip, sends a reply.
Over 6 copies it scored 0.62 points above the inside design. The likely range includes zero.
With the calculator switched off, program questions score 0.0, so the model really uses it.
One check is incomplete: the swapped-reply test passed on 5 of 6 copies; one file was lost.

scenes.heading: Result three: a sleep that reached 76.1
caption: Result three, research only. Six starting models slept, then took a kept-aside test and averaged 76.1 out of 100.
Each night took 256 updates. The research loop's own sleep needs 558 to 610.
The 71.3 line is that loop's stored number, not a side-by-side test. Each starting model ran once.

scenes.heading: Sleep: what the result does not show

caption.text: Transfer is not shown. Plain practice alone raised old skills by 2.11; the sleep added only 0.52.
Harm is disputed. The write-up says none against the model just before sleep, but the check against the original model fails on all six.
An earlier, different sleep did hurt old skills, then a lower learning rate fixed it. The stop rule never ended a night early.

labels.earlier: an earlier, different sleep: one old skill

The talker, the race and games come later.

scenes.heading: What would prove the idea wrong

caption.text: Rule one: gaining no more from size than the plain model, on both copies, means STOP.
Rule two: all parts at 3M must beat the plain partner by 3.0; under 1.0, find the broken part.
Rule three: domain mode needed +30; its first try scored -0.48: proved wrong.

scenes.heading: What to remember
caption: The thinking does the work, shown on one copy at the smallest size.
The calculator can sit outside. Sleep is a promising research result. Most of the rest is built or planned, not proven.
The plan's own judgment: nothing is ready to buy yet. No recipe has shown both halves of demonstrably works.
